  colours *TRUE* and *FALSE* in some order – representing the truth assignment

  triangle forces the three colours to be used on ``c1, c2, c3``.  If all three
  literals were coloured *FALSE*, then each ``cj`` would be forbidden from the
  colour *FALSE* and only two colours would remain for a three‑vertex triangle –
  impossible.  Hence at least one literal must be coloured *TRUE*, exactly the
  satisfaction condition.
